name: Frame by frame in the player (Bookmarks 1.4.0 / 2.2.0) on Frame Counter Transcode (2023) (MPEG-2 at 29.97 fps, transcoded to HLS; Initialize-Sandbox.ps1 -PlayerTracks adds it). Every frame of the video carries its number as a 12-bit code, read back through a canvas, so each step is proved to show exactly the next or the previous frame, paused, with the position in the middle of it: . while playing, . and , (three quick presses all counted), the two player buttons and a held key; then Adjust on 'Frames R' (0:04-0:06) from the player's Bookmarks list: the start shown, stepped with the keys in the bar, Right and Enter to Set start here and to Save, the saved start exactly 3 frames later (read back, and shown again when adjusted again), Escape saving nothing. As admin; the video's bookmarks reset first and deleted at the end.

steps.name: find Frame Counter Transcode (2023)
steps.eval: (async () => { const r = await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Frame Counter', Limit: 10 }); const m = r.Items.find(i => i.Name === 'Frame Counter Transcode (2023)'); if (!m) throw new Error('Frame Counter Transcode (2023) is not in the library: Initialize-Sandbox.ps1 -PlayerTracks adds it'); return m.Id; })()

steps.name: its video stream's frame rate
steps.eval: (async () => { const it = await ApiClient.getItem(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), __vars.movieId); const v = it.MediaSources[0].MediaStreams.find(s => s.Type === 'Video'); return { real: v.RealFrameRate, average: v.AverageFrameRate, codec: v.Codec }; })()

steps.name: reset its bookmarks to 'Frames P' (a point at 0:02) and 'Frames R' (the range 0:04-0:06)
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movieId; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } for (const body of [{ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 20000000, Name: 'Frames P' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 40000000, EndTicks: 60000000, Name: 'Frames R' }]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))).map(b => b.Name + ' ' + b.StartTicks + (b.EndTicks ? '-' + b.EndTicks : ''));

steps.name: details page with a Play button
the frame reader: each frame of the video carries its number as a 12-bit code in its top band (white is 1, bit 0 on the left), read through a canvas
steps.eval: (window.__fc = { video: () => document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'), fps: (30000 / 1001), no: () => { const v = window.__fc.video(); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 640; c.height = 360; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(v, 0, 0, 640, 360); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, 640, 60).data; let n = 0; for (let b = 0; b < 12; b++) { const x = Math.floor((b + 0.5) * 640 / 12); if (d[(30 * 640 + x) * 4] > 128) n |= 1 << b; } return n; }, settled: () => { const v = window.__fc.video(); return !!v && v.paused && !v.seeking && v.readyState >= 2; }, at: () => { const f = window.__fc.video().currentTime * window.__fc.fps; const k = Math.floor(f + 1e-6); return { frame: k, offMiddle: Math.abs(f - k - 0.5) }; } }, true)

steps.name: played as Transcode
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const s = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Sessions', { deviceId: ApiClient.deviceId() })); const p = s[0] && s[0].PlayState; return !!p && p.PlayMethod === 'Transcode'; })()

steps.name: the player buttons: Back and Forward one frame right after Bookmarks
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnFrameBack'); const f = document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnFrameForward'); return !!b && !!f && b.previousElementSibling.classList.contains('btnBookmarkList') && b.nextElementSibling === f && b.getAttribute('title') === 'Back one frame (,)' && f.getAttribute('title') === 'Forward one frame (.)' && !!b.querySelector('.material-icons.navigate_before') && !!f.querySelector('.material-icons.navigate_next'); })()

steps.message: the saved start is not exactly 3 frames after the old one
steps.assert: (() => { const r = __vars.after.find(b => b.name === 'Frames R'); const p = __vars.after.find(b => b.name === 'Frames P'); const f = t => Math.floor(t * (30000 / 1001) / 10000000 + 1e-6); return r.start === 40874167 && f(r.start) - f(40000000) === 3 && r.end === 60000000 && p.start === 20000000; })()

steps.name: delete the video's bookmarks
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).length;
